english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something that is cute and lovable.
Choose this more explicit equivalent when emphasizing that someone or something is lovable and pleasing rather than merely good-looking.
Use this when “precious” means endearingly cute or beloved rather than materially valuable.
Use this for a person or appearance that is endearing or pleasing to look at, including when “sweet” means cute.
Use 可愛 when dear means lovely, endearing, or pleasing.
Use 可愛 when lovely describes someone or something charming, cute, or endearing rather than simply beautiful.
